Remark
[$\omega $-contractive semigroups] ↗ thm:hille-yosida-theorem 1. ch7:7.4.2-rem-1\group Semigroup Theory

A semigroup is $\omega $-contractive when $\| S(t)\| \le e^{\omega t}$. A closed densely defined operator $A$ generates such a semigroup iff \[ (\omega ,\infty )\subset \rho (A),\qquad \| R_\lambda \| \le \frac1{\lambda -\omega }\quad (\lambda >\omega ). \tag {23} \]
